title: Putting It Together
coreMove: Link the strategy pieces into one response where each part strengthens the others.
sourcePressure: This synthesis chapter joins diagnosis, action, force, timing, structure, and reinforcement into integrated strategic practice rather than a recap of separate concepts. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Putting it together means summarizing the prior concepts in order.

hook: opening with a generic definition of Putting It Together

any hook that starts with Strategy is...
counterintuition: Most people think X, but actually Y

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
